title: WhatsApp says it is is fixing an issue that disabled several accounts | TechCrunch
summary: For the last few hours, several people across social media have reported that their WhatsApp accounts have been blocked and put “under review” by Meta. We’ve taken action to restore affected accounts,” a company spokesperson said.
